name: Yukino Kajihara
source:
Yukino is perhaps the most enigmatic member of the Human Reignition Project, taking a long time to truly open up to anyone. Those who manage to get on Yukino's good side will find a girl who is strong-willed and opinionated, but more than a little afraid to show it.

Growing up with almost half a dozen younger brothers hasn't exactly turned Yukino into a tomboy, but it has given her a no-nonsense attitude a lot of the time. It's easy to mistake that for iciness, when really she's just a bit awkward at expressing herself.

It's an awareness of that trait, as well as an unhappy home life that drives Yukino to join the HRP and hopefully meet people that she can actually connect with.
